io.github.jabrena.juno.classfile
Reads standard JVM class files and resolves their constant-pool references, independent of Juno's own bytecode subset or IR.
io.github.jabrena.juno.ir
Juno's own intermediate representation: a non-SSA, block-structured form that lowering produces from JVM bytecode, optimize transforms, and backend consumes to generate assembly.
